dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular polygonal and circular rings along the lateral midsection. The perimeters are composed of high-intensity pixels forming jagged borders around darker interior centers with sharp gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity white clusters lacking internal gradients. These are concentrated primarily in the anterior lateral region, forming small, asymmetrical groups of 3-5 distinct points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary grouping of three prominent macro-annuli in the central region forms an obtuse triangle. A secondary series of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a sub-linear sequence extending towards the flipper base.
